summary: This is a routine Form 6-K filing by First Mining Gold Corp., a foreign private issuer, reporting a voluntary short extension of the Environmental Assessment decision date for its Springpole Gold Project until June 30, 2026, and announcing that two First Nations have completed their independent impact assessment. The filing discusses permitting progress and community engagement. It does not involve an acquisition, divestiture, tender offer, going-private, restructuring, or any other special situation. It is purely an operational update on a permitting timeline and contains no event or transaction that fits the special-situations categories.
